turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My sourdough keeps coming out flat as a pancake.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Often that's the last rise. Do you proof it on the counter?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A slow overnight proof in the fridge makes shaping easier. Want to switch, or tweak your counter timing first?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need to talk to my roommate for a second. Stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lucas, you fell asleep last night. How much did you miss?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I saw the bit where they escape the boat.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That was like twenty minutes in!

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It was very warm on that sofa, okay?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Don't tell me. I'll finish it on my own.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You said that last time and never did.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: This time I mean it. Is there any of that pizza left?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, fridge or counter for the next attempt?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll adjust the counter first, one change at a time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Very scientific. Try cutting the final rise by about a third and do the poke test, it should spring back slowly.
